title: story-051 silently supersedes story-048's 'mint path kept verbatim / identical dispatcher' clause: UniPoolerV2._dispatch now differs from BalancerPoolerV2._dispatch by the HookNotSet guard, and story-048 still asserts the verbatim clause
description: With comments stripped, _dispatch differs from BalancerPoolerV2._dispatch by exactly one statement: `if (address(hook) == _defaultHook) revert UniPoolerV2__HookNotSet();`. _psmDonate differs only in revert-string prefixes. An un-hooked UniPoolerV2 now reverts every index-4 mint, where BalancerPoolerV2 would silently accrue zero debt, so 'identical dispatcher' no longer holds until setHook is called. The contract @dev header was reworded honestly (story-051 Autonomous Decision 8).
impact: None. The deviation is a security improvement: the L-21 HookNotSet guard.
severityJustification: Story-048 still says the mint path is kept 'verbatim' and 'identical' to BalancerPoolerV2._dispatch. Since 267660b, UniPoolerV2._dispatch adds the HookNotSet guard as its first statement, and story-051 supersedes the clause without amending or waiving story-048. The divergence is intended and safer, because it closes L-21's silent zero-mint-debt path, so Law 1 is not engaged. Law 2 does require the authoritative stories to agree with the shipped code. A later reviewer or agent grading against story-048 would flag the guard as a deviation, or might 'restore' verbatim parity. That is unlikely to happen without review, so this is informational. A related bookkeeping point: story-051 is still in review/ while its code has landed. Report it as F-03-051 at informational severity.
recommendation: Add an explicit waiver of story-048's verbatim clause in story-051, or amend story-048 to reference it, naming the HookNotSet guard as the sole intended divergence. Move story-051 out of review/ once accepted.
specText: story-048: "The mint path (`_dispatch`) is kept verbatim, so the NFT minter, the mint-debt hook and NFT index 4 all see an identical dispatcher."; Plan §4 Stage 1a: "The `_dispatch` override copied **verbatim**"; "**Kept verbatim.** `_dispatch`, `_psmDonate`, ..."
actualBehavior: With comments stripped, _dispatch differs from BalancerPoolerV2._dispatch by exactly one statement: `if (address(hook) == _defaultHook) revert UniPoolerV2__HookNotSet();`. _psmDonate differs only in revert-string prefixes. An un-hooked UniPoolerV2 now reverts every index-4 mint, where BalancerPoolerV2 would silently accrue zero debt, so 'identical dispatcher' no longer holds until setHook is called. The contract @dev header was reworded honestly (story-051 Autonomous Decision 8).
deviation: Story-048's verbatim/identical-dispatcher clause is superseded by story-051, which explicitly mandates the guard as the first line of UniPoolerV2._dispatch. The later, owner-directed spec wins, so this is not a Law-2 violation of the code. But story-051 never states that it waives 048's clause, and the 048 document still asserts it. A reader grading against 048 alone would raise a false deviation.
relatedPrior: Run-20 DEDUP-20-01 law2Annotation explicitly asked for this waiver to be recorded if the in-_dispatch guard was adopted. It was adopted (L-21 fix) but the waiver was not written; this finding is that follow-through.
